news.title: 2026 Honors Convocation marks University Honors Program’s 70th anniversary
news.summary_en: The University Honors Program recognized two faculty members and a student for their contributions to the program during Honors Convocation, an annual celebration for first-year honors students, which took place Aug. 23 at the Burge Union.

news.title: Second annual Falling into AI Summit will bring experts from Google, Amazon to KU
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas is hosting the second annual Falling into AI Summit from Sept. 22-24, bringing together leaders from KU, KU Medical Center, Google, Amazon Web Services, Apple and artificial intelligence industry partners to explore how AI is transforming education, healthcare, research, workforce development and society.

news.title: Fall Design Professional Lecture Series brings acclaimed artists and designers to KU
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas School of Architecture & Design will welcome seven accomplished artists and designers for the Fall 2026 Design Professional Lecture Series. news.title: ‘Nollywood’ film industry still tethered to patriarchal stereotypes despite progress of female characters, expert says
news.summary_en: In a new article, Abisola Akínsìkù, a doctoral candidate in English at the University of Kansas, uses feminism as a conceptual lens to interrogate how female characters are portrayed in the burgeoning “Nollywood” film industry of Nigeria.

news.title: KU ROTC will host 2026 KU 9/11 Memorial Stair Climb
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas Reserve Officer Training Corps programs will host the 2026 KU 9/11 Memorial Stair Climb on Sept. 11 at David Booth Kansas Memorial Stadium to honor and remember the courage and sacrifice of the firefighters, first responders and service members who responded on Sept. 11, 2001.

news.title: KU launches website dedicated to businesses
news.summary_en: The website, partner.ku.edu, serves as a gateway to KU’s business-focused resources, connecting employers with world-class research, core laboratories, workforce training and top talent.

news.title: KU to host summit on Indigenous food sovereignty
news.summary_en: The Office of Sovereign Partnerships & Indigenous Initiatives at the University of Kansas and partners will host a daylong summit Sept. 16 featuring a keynote by alumna Lois Stevens (Oneida Nation) and several panel sessions along with a screening of “Seed Warriors,” a film by KU faculty member Rebekka Schlichting (Ioway Tribe of Kansas and Nebraska).

news.title: KU Transportation Center keeps Kansans connected
news.summary_en: The KU Transportation Center supports the roads, routes and relationships that strengthen the Sunflower State. Part of the School of Engineering, the center has partnered with transportation professionals, transit providers and local governments throughout Kansas.
